name: Arizona

response.rule_text: Records must be furnished 'promptly' (immediate access presumed); no day count in statute, A.R.S. § 39-121.01(D)(1). Courts read 'promptly' as 'at once or without delay' (West Valley View).

fees.labor_rule: Commercial-purpose requests may be charged for time, materials, equipment and personnel, A.R.S. § 39-121.03(A).
fees.copy_rule: Custodian 'may charge a fee if the facilities are available' (§ 39-121.01(D)(1)); may require advance payment for copies/postage when mailing. RCFP fee sections for Arizona are blank.
fees.waiver_rule: Records for purposes listed in A.R.S. §§ 39-122 or 39-127 furnished without charge (§ 39-121.01(D)(1)).

appeal.rule_text: No administrative appeal is required before suit; denial is challenged by special action in superior court under A.R.S. § 39-121.02. Access is 'deemed denied' if the custodian fails to promptly respond, § 39-121.01(E). Ombudsman-Citizens Aide may take complaints (A.R.S. §§ 41-1371 to -1378) but this is not a records appeal.

exemptions_citation: No specific exemptions codified in the Public Records Law (common-law balancing)
